title: Shemirat Halashon 25

chapters.title: Speaking Lashon HaRa to spouses and partners
Speaking to relatives and informing to non-Jews
Making fun of others and accepting Lashon HaRa
Managing conversation at home and the Shabbat table

summary: Rabbi Soffer goes through the laws of Shemirat HaLashon from the Hafetz Chaim, covering when one may or may not speak negatively to spouses or business partners, the prohibition of informing on Jews to non-Jews, and the rules regarding listening to and stopping derogatory speech at home.
questions: When is it permitted to share negative information with a spouse or business partner?
Why is telling a non-Jew negative things about a Jew considered such a severe transgression?
What is the responsibility of the head of the household regarding conversation at the Shabbat table?
